workflowName: CDF Fund Allocation and Budget Control
schedule: Annual allocation and monthly budget control scan
escalationTrigger: Allocation, account, category or balance evidence is missing or contradictory
escalationOwner: Ministry CDF Finance Officer and Council Accounting Officer
purpose: Verify that the CDF fund-year and constituency budget envelope is correctly allocated before commitments are created.
institution: Ministry of Finance, Ministry CDF Office and Local Authority

steps.name: Confirm fund-year allocation
steps.explanation: Match the source allocation to the fund year, constituency and receiving institution.
steps.requiredEvidence: Allocation instrument and source event

steps.name: Validate category and account controls
steps.explanation: Check category rules, council account and available balance.
steps.requiredEvidence: Budget extract, category calculation and bank evidence

steps.name: Publish controlled budget envelope
steps.explanation: Record the approved oversight projection and reporting calendar.
steps.requiredEvidence: Approved budget record and audit correlation ID

rules.explanation: A controlled CDF budget requires a positive approved allocation.

escalations.action: Request missing allocation or account evidence
Escalate unresolved budget or category exception

schedule: Weekly application and approval pipeline review
escalationTrigger: Application, WDC, CDFC, council or configured provincial decision is overdue
purpose: Move a community need through WDC scrutiny, CDFC review, council appraisal and required approval.
institution: Community, WDC, CDFC, Local Authority, Provincial Administration and Ministry CDF Office

steps.name: Register and screen application
steps.explanation: Confirm applicant, location, category, duplicate status and minimum evidence.
steps.requiredEvidence: Application, identity, location and need evidence

steps.name: Review WDC recommendation
steps.explanation: Check scrutiny, scoring, participation and prioritisation evidence.
steps.requiredEvidence: Minutes, attendance, score and recommendation

steps.name: Complete council appraisal
steps.explanation: Review technical, financial, legal and safeguards readiness.
steps.requiredEvidence: Appraisal, estimate, safeguards and budget match

steps.name: Record approval decision
steps.explanation: Preserve the authorised approval, return or rejection decision.
steps.requiredEvidence: Decision record and audit correlation ID

rules.explanation: The application must be associated with the configured constituency scope.

escalations.action: Request missing application or review evidence
Escalate overdue approval or unresolved conflict

schedule: Daily procurement and award control scan
escalationTrigger: Threshold, conflict, supplier, evaluation or award evidence is incomplete
escalationOwner: Council Procurement Officer and Provincial Procurement Oversight
purpose: Verify procurement planning, method, evaluation, award and contract readiness for an approved CDF project.
institution: Local Authority Procurement Unit and Evaluation Committee

steps.name: Validate procurement plan and method
steps.explanation: Match the procurement method to the approved project, threshold and current rule version.
steps.requiredEvidence: Procurement plan, specification and threshold assessment

steps.name: Review evaluation evidence
steps.explanation: Check bids, evaluation, conflicts, supplier eligibility and recommendation.
steps.requiredEvidence: Bids, evaluation report and declarations

steps.name: Confirm award and contract readiness
steps.explanation: Verify award decision, notification and contract evidence.
steps.requiredEvidence: Award decision, notifications and contract

rules.explanation: CDF procurement must link to an approved project.

escalations.action: Request missing procurement evidence
Freeze award review and convene procurement exception review

schedule: Monthly milestone and quarterly monitoring review
escalationTrigger: Delay, quality concern, missing inspection or community concern exceeds target
escalationOwner: Council Technical Officer and Provincial Monitoring Officer
purpose: Verify that approved CDF outputs are delivered against milestones, evidence and community expectations.
institution: Contractor, Local Authority, WDC, Community, MP, Province and Ministry

steps.name: Confirm mobilisation and baseline
steps.explanation: Record site handover, work plan, baseline, risks and expected outputs.
steps.requiredEvidence: Site handover, baseline and work plan

steps.name: Verify milestone delivery
steps.explanation: Compare contractor progress to inspection, geolocation and community evidence.
steps.requiredEvidence: Inspection report, photos, measurements and feedback

steps.name: Record monitoring outcome
steps.explanation: Pass, warn, hold or escalate the milestone based on configured rules.
steps.requiredEvidence: Signed monitoring conclusion and action record

rules.explanation: A progress conclusion requires a measurable milestone and evidence reference.

escalations.action: Request missing milestone or inspection evidence
Escalate delay, quality or community concern

schedule: Daily payment and reconciliation control scan
escalationTrigger: Unsupported payment, duplicate invoice, budget variance or failed settlement is detected
escalationOwner: Council Accounting Officer and Internal Auditor
purpose: Match CDF payments to approved budget, contract, verified milestone, voucher, bank settlement and ledger evidence.
institution: Contractor, WDC, CDFC, MP where configured, Council Finance, Bank and Ledger

steps.name: Match payment request
steps.explanation: Match invoice or IPC to contract, budget, milestone and inspection evidence.
steps.requiredEvidence: Invoice, IPC, contract, inspection and budget evidence

steps.name: Review approval segregation
steps.explanation: Check preparer, approver, duplicate and amount controls.
steps.requiredEvidence: Voucher, approval history and segregation record

steps.name: Reconcile settlement and ledger
steps.explanation: Match bank settlement, ledger posting and project balance.
steps.requiredEvidence: Bank event, ledger entry and reconciliation statement

rules.explanation: The paid source amount must not exceed the approved project amount.

escalations.action: Place payment review on hold and request missing evidence
Review duplicate, unsupported or unreconciled payment signal

escalationTrigger: Report is overdue or figures cannot be reconciled to source evidence
escalationOwner: Provincial Local Government Officer and Ministry CDF Office
purpose: Compile, reconcile, certify and publish approved CDF financial, project, procurement and beneficiary information.
institution: WDC, Local Authority, Provincial Administration and Ministry

steps.name: Collect quarterly evidence
steps.explanation: Collect financial, project, procurement, beneficiary and monitoring information.
steps.requiredEvidence: Quarterly source report package

steps.name: Reconcile and certify report
steps.explanation: Reconcile report figures to bank, ledger, project and workflow records.
steps.requiredEvidence: Reconciliation and certification

steps.name: Submit and disclose approved information
steps.explanation: Submit to province and ministry and publish only disclosure-approved information.
steps.requiredEvidence: Submission receipt and publication record

rules.explanation: The project must have a current report for the applicable reporting period.

escalations.action: Request missing report evidence
Escalate overdue CDF report

schedule: Risk-based monthly scan and annual fund-year audit
escalationTrigger: Material, repeated or unresolved CDF finding requires escalation or referral
purpose: Evaluate CDF financial, procurement, delivery, value-for-money and governance evidence and track corrective action.
institution: Local Authority Internal Audit, Provincial Administration, Ministry and External Audit Liaison

steps.name: Select and scope audit
steps.explanation: Select project or fund-year scope using risk, materiality and repeat findings.
steps.requiredEvidence: Audit scope and risk basis

steps.name: Evaluate compliance evidence
steps.explanation: Test budget, procurement, payment, delivery, reporting and governance controls.
steps.requiredEvidence: Audit working papers and source snapshot

steps.name: Track corrective action and closure
steps.explanation: Assign, monitor and verify corrective actions or formal referrals.
steps.requiredEvidence: Finding, management response and closure evidence

rules.explanation: All audit and control actions must remain visible until accepted closure.

escalations.action: Request management response to audit finding
Escalate unresolved or repeated finding

schedule: Quarterly release calendar and receipt reconciliation
escalationTrigger: Prior report, bank account, release amount or receipt evidence is missing or contradictory
escalationOwner: Ministry CDF Finance Officer and Council Accounting Officer
purpose: Control scheduled CDF releases before and after dispatch through financial source systems.
institution: Ministry of Finance, Ministry CDF Office, Local Authority and Bank

steps.name: Check release conditions
steps.explanation: Confirm prior reporting, budget, bank and compliance conditions.
steps.requiredEvidence: Current report, balance and compliance evidence

steps.name: Validate release instruction
steps.explanation: Match amount, fund year, constituency and authorised account.
steps.requiredEvidence: Release instruction and account confirmation

steps.name: Reconcile receipt
steps.explanation: Confirm bank receipt and reconcile the source allocation.
steps.requiredEvidence: Bank receipt and reconciliation statement

rules.explanation: A scheduled release requires current reporting evidence.

escalations.action: Request missing release or report evidence
Escalate unreconciled or unsupported disbursement

escalationTrigger: Complaint is overdue, sensitive, retaliatory or indicates a serious integrity issue
escalationOwner: Council Complaints Officer and Provincial Integrity Officer
purpose: Register, classify, investigate, resolve, refer and close CDF community complaints and protected disclosures.
institution: Community, WDC, Local Authority, Province, Ministry and Independent Oversight

steps.name: Register and protect complaint
steps.explanation: Assign a case reference, sensitivity, consent and protection controls.
steps.requiredEvidence: Complaint record and acknowledgement

steps.name: Classify and investigate
steps.explanation: Assess jurisdiction, conflict, urgency and evidence before investigation or referral.
steps.requiredEvidence: Classification, conflict check and investigation plan

steps.name: Resolve or refer
steps.explanation: Record response, remedy, referral or protected closure with reasons.
steps.requiredEvidence: Decision, response and closure or referral evidence

rules.explanation: A complaint cannot close without a recorded outcome or referral.

escalations.action: Request investigation progress and complainant update
Escalate overdue, sensitive or serious-integrity complaint

schedule: Application review and monthly support monitoring
escalationTrigger: Eligibility, duplicate support, procurement, use-of-support or repayment evidence is missing
escalationOwner: CDFC Chairperson and Council Empowerment Officer
purpose: Control CDF empowerment, skills, equipment and loan support from eligibility through monitoring and close-out.
institution: Community, WDC, CDFC, Local Authority and Skills or Enterprise Support Officers

steps.name: Verify applicant and eligibility
steps.explanation: Check identity, constituency, group composition, duplicate support and business or skills evidence.
steps.requiredEvidence: Identity, constituency, plan and eligibility evidence

steps.name: Review and approve support plan
steps.explanation: Assess viability, inclusion, local employment, sustainability and support type.
steps.requiredEvidence: Score, minutes, support plan and approval decision

steps.name: Monitor use and close out
steps.explanation: Verify equipment, funds, training, activity, repayment or sustainability outcome.
steps.requiredEvidence: Monitoring visit, beneficiary feedback and outcome evidence

rules.explanation: Support must not duplicate another active CDF intervention without an approved exception.

escalations.action: Request missing eligibility or support-plan evidence
Escalate unsupported or poorly monitored support
